interpretation_ru: На том же development F1 вырос 0.1111→0.2 и recall 1/17→2/17, но прежний единственный TP потерян, добавлены два новых TP и один FP. Пропущены 15/17 нарушений; качества для самостоятельного применения недостаточно. Более высокие F1/recall не означают доказанного обобщения.
decision_ru: Кандидат сохранён для анализа, автоматически не принят; active pointer оставлен на schema-v2. Следующий шаг — локальный аудит покрытия двух правил и ошибок объектов/действий/порядка, без повторного обучения вслепую.
limitations: The candidate uses six overlapping frames while the intentionally byte-identical frozen prompt still describes two. The effect of this known protocol-text mismatch is unverified.
Accuracy, precision, recall and F1 cover completed predictions only; failures, missing outcomes and partial results are never negative predictions.
When coverage differs, paired metrics are restricted to the common completed subset; this selective subset cannot replace full-development performance and failure rates.
Frame equivalence uses saved timestamps, JPEG hashes and sizes, not new video decoding or proof of semantic visibility.
Development is not independent; five videos have known previous context. Holdout was not inferred.
Only two fixed observable criteria are covered. No weights were trained and no official temporal score is evaluated.

A nominal local window spans about 7.5 seconds, and requests have no memory of preceding windows. Overlap six shifts window boundaries; its windows are not nested supersets of the old windows, so some context can be lost as well as gained.

A plus/minus-two-second context threshold is a diagnostic heuristic, not an official criterion, necessary condition or established explanation of false negatives. This helper does not recalculate that context heuristic or predict recall from it.

Prior post-hoc annotation-time counts can exceed the number of false-negative videos because duplicate aliases have different timestamps; actual prior aggregate counts are included separately when that artifact exists.
The candidate is not accepted automatically or on a selectively completed subset; conclusions about the full development set require all 32 paired outcomes and explicit coverage.

arithmetic_reference.purpose: Recall alone is insufficient; this is arithmetic on the 32 labels, not a trained system.
